name: Zapret Service Control
description:
Monitor and control the zapret systemd service from the top panel.
This extension is a control GUI for zapret (https://github.com/bol-van/zapret) and requires it to be installed and registered as zapret.service.
Install guide: https://keift.gitbook.io/guides/linux/install-zapret

The panel shows a Z icon with a colored status dot:
* green: zapret.service is running
* orange: zapret.service is stopped
* red: zapret.service is not installed

Menu actions allow starting, stopping, restarting, enabling/disabling autostart, and copying the detailed systemctl status to the clipboard.

Starting, stopping and restarting the service requires polkit authorization, which will be requested automatically when an action is triggered.
